goal: Break up a monolithic 1,500-line P2P message handler into dedicated per-message helpers
Make message handling logic easier to navigate, encapsulate, and review for maintainers
reviewability: Nine move-only commits are cleanly rebased and verified with diff tools
agreement: Broad agreement that isolating message logic improves navigation and review (stickies-v, maflcko, vasild)
Verified as clean move-only commits via range-diff and coverage testing (l0rinc, pablomartin4btc, pseudoramdom)
Nonblocking concern about helper indirection was conceded to group consensus (davidgumberg)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it provides structural cleanup to central P2P message handling
Improves code readability and encapsulation without functional, security, or protocol changes
